Class BlazeBitePayments

public class BlazeBitePayments

Deserializes customer payment documents from Google Firestore into strongly-typed Apex objects. Supports payment details, orders, refunds, checkout fees, customer contact info, and feedback structures as returned by the Firestore REST API.

Group:
    Data Transfer Objects (DTO)

Since:
    04/03/2021

Version:
    1.6


Change Log

  • 04/03/2021 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 07/25/2021 - v1.1 - Adds refunds data structure.
  • 07/10/2022 - v1.2 - Adds externalId to refunds.
  • 10/31/2023 - v1.3 - Fix issue where VenueId could be blank. Add new fields from payments: checkoutType, tax, ua, venueName.
  • 09/27/2025 - v1.4 - Add new fields from payments: sourceApp, customerPhone, customerInfo (firstName, lastName, email, phoneNumber), checkout (grossUpPaymentFees, netAmount, orderSubTotal, orderTotal, paymentFees, paymentMethodRequired, serviceFees, subTotalBeforeFees, tax, tip), fees (isConvenienceFeeToUserEnabled, paymentGatewayFees, paymentTransactionFlatFee, paymentTransactionPct, servicingFees). API version updated to 64.
  • 10/04/2025 - v1.5 - Fees can be null if not presented in the payment document.
  • 03/28/2026 - v1.6 - Update ApexDoc comments to follow standard format.
